اخضوضبن (form XII)
# اِخْضَوْضَبْنَ (iḵḍawḍabna) /ix.dˤaw.dˤab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْضَوْضَبَ (iḵḍawḍaba)
# اِخْضَوْضِبْنَ (iḵḍawḍibna) /ix.dˤaw.dˤib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْضَوْضَبَ (iḵḍawḍaba)
